# Framework fixture — comparison map

The map describes argumentative relationships, not a citation network or an automatic ranking.

| From | Relation | To | Shared/different fields and locators | Effect on judgment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F-001 | agreement | F-005 | same endpoint, denominator, catalyst window; F-001 p. 2 Table 1, F-005 p. 4 Table 2 | supports a local L1 association and independent repetition |
| F-001 | contradiction | F-004 | endpoint is aligned, but substrate and work-up differ; F-001 p. 2, F-004 p. 3 | requires a substrate/processing boundary; no universal claim |
| F-001 | extension | F-006 | F-006 adds a hindered substrate and records a by-product; F-006 p. 5 Table 3 | extends the question to failure conditions |
| F-001 | replication | F-005 | independent team and same nominal endpoint; locators above | increases local confidence, not generality |
| F-006 | boundary | F-001 | steric substrate differs from the original substrate class | marks where the association may fail |
| F-002 | NOT_COMPARABLE | F-006 | docking score versus isolated yield; no common endpoint or denominator | preserve both local findings; do not rank |

Where the condition or measurement difference cannot be resolved, the relationship remains `NOT_COMPARABLE` and is not converted into a contradiction.
